title: Scalar unit equation for a fixed strict comparison
statement: For fixed normalized scalar compatibility and strict scalar comparison data, the scalar-adjunction unit agrees with extension by zero on every cochain complex.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03EK, 0E8I and 0941; generator formula for the unit and extensionality.

proof.text: Evaluate both composites on extension-by-zero generators. The normalized finite and system comparison formulas send the unit generator 1 tensor x to the same extension summand. Sheafification, complex, and strict-tower extensionality give equality in every degree and level.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI, 03EK, 0E8I and 0941; generator formula for the unit and extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarUnitEquation
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (tc : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (sc : ScalarCompatibility l E j o)
    (r : ScalarComparison l E j o sc tc) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ,
      scalarUnitTower l E X ((OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o).obj P) ≫
          r.iso.hom.app P =
        (Functor.constComp ℕᵒᵖ P (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)).inv ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (scalarUnitTower l E U P)
            (OpenSemilinearTensor.extensionComplex l E j o)
